name: Edison Township Engineering & Zoning Department
description: Administers municipal zoning approvals, building setback reviews, tree removal clearances, driveway curb cuts, road opening excavations, stormwater drainage, and land development site plans for the Township of Edison.

operating_hours.intake_cutoff: 4:00 PM for daily plan and permit drop-off

submission_channels.name: Division of Zoning Intake Counter
submission_channels.details: Edison Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, 2nd Floor. Bring 3 signed & sealed property surveys and payment check payable to 'Township of Edison'.

submission_channels.name: Postal Mail Submission
submission_channels.details: Mail completed application and sealed surveys to: Edison Township Zoning Department, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817.

standard_processing_time: 10 to 14 business days from receipt of completed application and survey
